drafts_today.text:
Not gatekeeping this one, ladies over 40:

Dry winter skin doesn't need a 10-step routine.

1. Gentle gel cleanser, never bar soap
2. Serum while skin is still damp
3. Press (don't rub) a rich cream to seal it

Save this for tonight. Which step do you skip?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Flat lay on a white towel by the bathroom window: your RIMAN cleanser, serum and cream in a row with a handwritten '1 2 3' sticky note above each.
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds, vertical, bathroom window light: 3 quick clips, each with a number on screen: (1) lather the RIMAN Balancing Gel Cleanser in your hands, (2) pat serum onto damp cheeks, (3) press the cream in with flat palms. End on the 3 jars lined up.

drafts_today.text:
Winter skin starter pack after 40:

- Cheeks tight by noon
- Makeup clinging to dry patches
- Hands looking older than your face
- Lips go first

What helped me: a gentler cleanser, layering on damp skin, a richer cream at night.

Which one is you?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your hands holding a warm mug next to your RIMAN cream jar on the windowsill, with a cozy sweater sleeve in frame (simple 1:1 or 16:9 photo).
drafts_today.video_tip: 8 seconds: a quick close-up of the furnace vent or thermostat, then your hands rubbing in cream by a window, then cream pressed onto your cheek. On-screen text: 'Winter skin starter pack 40+'.

drafts_today.text:
"My cream stopped working."

It probably didn't. Dry winter air and furnace heat pull water out of skin faster.

Put it on damp skin, press it in, and add a second thin layer on your cheeks at night.

I use my RIMAN Incellderm cream for that last step.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Close-up of your open RIMAN cream jar beside a few water droplets on the counter, natural morning light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: splash water on your face, pat lightly with a towel (leave it damp), then slowly press cream in with both palms. On-screen text: 'It's not the cream. It's the timing.'

drafts_today.topic: GLP-1 after 60: lift, don't just shrink
drafts_today.text:
The scale can't tell you if you're losing fat or muscle.

A new Nature Medicine trial put adults 50–70 on tirzepatide for 40 weeks. Half also did strength training 3x a week, and the lifters kept more muscle.

On a GLP-1 past 60? Ask about protein and lifting, not just the dose.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: step on a bathroom scale, then cut to you doing a few slow chair squats or lifting a light dumbbell.

drafts_today.topic: Viral liver lists aren't written for cirrhosis
drafts_today.text:
Those viral "8 rules to protect your liver" lists are written for fatty liver.

If you're living with cirrhosis, some of that advice doesn't fit, and some "natural" supplements can do real harm.

Before adding anything new, run it past your liver specialist first.
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: hold up a supplement bottle, shake your head, then hold up a notepad that says "ask my specialist".
